profile.name: Christian Ganang
profile.about:
I'm a student from Indonesia with a strong interest in 3D modeling and digital art. I enjoy turning simple ideas into 3D objects and exploring different ways to make my work look more detailed and visually appealing.

I've been learning 3D modeling since mid-2025, mainly using Blender. My projects range from simple objects and furniture to detailed assets. I'm continuously learning, improving my skills, and looking for new opportunities to create better work.

projects.title: Donut Project
projects.summary: A donut, a plate, and a mug. A simple still life explored through shape, materials, and light.
projects.description:
A Blender study of a donut, plate, and mug.

The original presentation pairs a full-color render with a solid render, showing how the forms come together before and after materials and lighting.

projects.title: Cabinet Project
projects.summary: A furniture modeling study, from wireframe structure to a cabinet in a lit interior scene.
projects.description:
A hard-surface cabinet study made in Blender.

The original presentation includes a wireframe view and a full render. Open doors reveal the shelving inside, while the final scene places the cabinet against an interior wall.

projects.title: Flower Project
projects.summary: A bright pink flower in a small pot, balancing playful color with simple forms.
projects.description:
A stylized potted flower modeled in Blender.

The presentation contrasts a full-color render with a wireframe view, revealing the mesh behind the petals, leaves, and pot.

projects.title: Bed Project
projects.summary: A wooden bed with pillows and a textured blanket, explored as an environment asset.
projects.description:
A bed and bedding study created in Blender.

A solid render shows the underlying forms, while the full render adds the wooden frame and textured blanket to the scene.
